description: What one acceptance redeemed. An invitation carries no secret, so acceptance names nothing: every pending invitation addressed to the caller's verified email is redeemed in one transaction. The list is empty when nothing was pending, which is what a repeated call answers.

memberships.description: One membership per invitation redeemed by this call, created or raised to the invited role. Bounded by the same 100 the acceptance transaction reads.

title: InvitationAcceptResult
